description: The CD Horizon ModuLeX 5.5 Spinal system by Medtronic is a complete thoracolumbar fixation system using the 5.5mm rod system. It features pedicle screws for use in the traditional pedicle screw as well as the medial cortical screw. In addition If features the option for Osteogrip threadform which has a cortical and cancellous thread.
